join a tight\-knit, six\-person engineering team at an early\-stage ai\-native healthtech startup that is building the agentic command center for healthcare administration — with a laser focus on eliminating the burden of administrative clinical tasks. you'll help develop the backend systems that power patient access to care and drive the company's primary growth lever: rapid customer onboarding. the work is high\-impact, patient\-facing, and spans secure processing of clinical information at scale.


this is a full\-time, on\-site role (five days per week) in **san francisco, ca**. visa sponsorship is available.

### **what you'll do**

* architect and deploy ai\-native backend systems that process high\-volume clinical data via api.
* shape upcoming product iterations end\-to\-end by integrating direct customer feedback into the development cycle.
* build reliable, secure agentic infrastructure capable of handling clinical information for millions of patients.
* own and evolve critical backend infrastructure, driving its technical direction.
* scale systems and architecture to support rapid customer onboarding and company growth.

### **what we're looking for**

**must\-haves:**

* 5\+ years of software engineering experience building and delivering production\-grade systems.
* proficiency in at least one systems programming language: c, c\+\+, rust, or go.
* experience designing and implementing scalable backend systems or infrastructure.
* strong proficiency in **python**.
* infrastructure\-as\-code experience with **terraform** or a comparable tool.
* understanding of prompt engineering and working with llms.
* experience with distributed systems concepts (consensus, replication, fault tolerance).
* experience with database systems or data storage technologies.
* solid git/version control practices with a strong github contribution profile showing active, meaningful commits.
* experience with performance optimization and profiling of backend systems.
* currently employed at an established company.
* ability to work on\-site five days per week in san francisco.
* genuine passion for building impactful products in healthcare.

**nice to have:**

* experience with cloud platforms (aws, gcp, or azure) and/or containerization (docker, kubernetes).
* contributions to open source projects or public repositories.
* experience with testing frameworks and writing automated tests.

### **compensation \& benefits**

* **salary:** $120,000 – $250,000 per year, depending on experience.
* visa sponsorship available.

### **location**


on\-site, five days per week in **san francisco, ca**. the primary hiring location is the **los angeles, ca** metro area, with additional consideration for candidates in new york city and san francisco.

title: Data Scientist
description:
job overview  
we are seeking an energetic and innovative data scientist to join our dynamic analytics team. in this role, you will harness the power of data to drive strategic decision\-making, develop advanced machine learning models, and implement ai solutions that transform business processes. your expertise will contribute to building scalable data systems, conducting statistical analyses, and deploying predictive models across various platforms. this position offers an exciting opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies and big data systems, making a tangible impact on our organization’s growth and innovation.

duties

* design, develop, and optimize machine learning models using frameworks such as tensorflow and other ai tools to solve complex business problems.
* implement scalable data pipelines with etl processes, leveraging tools like talend, hadoop, spark, and sql databases to ensure efficient data flow.
* conduct statistical modeling and analysis using r, sas, and statistical analysis tools to extract actionable insights from large datasets.
* collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate ai models into production environments through model training, evaluation, and deployment on cloud services like aws.
* develop natural language processing (nlp) applications for text analysis and generate ai\-driven insights using generative ai techniques.
* design database schemas and optimize database performance for large\-scale data mining and analytics projects.
* utilize big data systems such as hadoop and spark implementation to process vast amounts of structured and unstructured data efficiently.
* engage in model evaluation, scalability testing, and continuous improvement of ai models to enhance predictive accuracy and robustness.
* support data analytics initiatives by creating dashboards with looker or similar visualization tools to communicate findings clearly.
* stay current with advancements in quantum engineering, machine learning frameworks, and ai implementation strategies to keep our solutions at the forefront of innovation.

experience

* proven experience as a data scientist or in a similar role with a strong background in machine learning/ai\-based analysis.
* hands\-on expertise with python, r, java, c, bash (unix shell), vba for scripting and automation tasks.
* deep understanding of big data systems including hadoop, spark implementation, and sql\-based databases.
* practical knowledge of cloud\-based machine learning services such as aws machine learning cloud services for model training and deployment.
* familiarity with statistical analysis for research purposes along with statistical modeling techniques for predictive analytics.
* experience working with natural language processing (nlp), generative ai models, and ai frameworks like tensorflow or similar platforms.
* knowledge of database design principles combined with experience in etl processes using talend or equivalent tools.
* ability to analyze large datasets using data mining techniques while ensuring scalability across big data environments.
* strong problem\-solving skills complemented by experience in model evaluation, validation, and deployment within enterprise settings.

join us if you’re passionate about leveraging data science to revolutionize industries through innovative ai solutions!

pay: $120,705\.36 \- $145,365\.59 per year

benefits:

* relocation assistance

work location: in person

title: Associate Scientific Technical Engineer II, PDS&T CMC
description:
**company description** **about abbvie**


abbvie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. we strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience \- and products and services in our allergan aesthetics portfolio. for more information about abbvie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. follow @abbvie on linkedin, facebook, instagram, x and youtube.

 **job description**  

while the ai innovation race in biopharma is focused on drug discovery, product development/ cmc represents the next barrier/ bottleneck. the complexity of biological systems, the rigor of regulatory expectations, the pace of pipeline growth, and the enormous value at stake make this one of the highest\-leverage domains for applied data science and ai in the entire pharmaceutical value chain.


we here at bts \- pdst, are building a dedicated, ai\-native team that is driving cutting edge programs across early stage, late stage and commercial product development to accelerate e2e product development and launch, maximize yields of block buster products. through our deep collaboration with pdst scientists we are boldly reimagining how abbvie can bring our pipeline products and lifesaving drugs to patients faster, safer and in cost effective manner fueled by ai.


this position is a highly technical, ai\-native role responsible for designing, building, and operating production\-grade data pipelines and data products that power ai/ml, analytics, and automation across abbvie's cmc and manufacturing ecosystem.


this role is embedded inside pdst and works at the frontier of pharmaceutical data engineering. you will integrate and harmonize data from the full spectrum of manufacturing and development systems — including mes, historians, lims, qms, erp, and instrument platforms — and transform it into reliable, governed, semantically rich data assets that data scientists, process engineers, and ai systems can actually use.

* enterprise\-scale scope: enterprise\-scale biologics portfolio spanning clinical, commercial, and lifecycle stages
* building ai playbook for the future: first\-in\-abbvie and first\-in\-biologics analytical approaches; you build the ai playbook for the future
* growth and impact: direct impact on regulatory submissions, commercial readiness, and manufacturing decisions through deep cross\-functional exposure to manufacturing, quality, regulatory, and scientific leadership
* mission: every model you build helps ensure safe, reliable medicines reach patients at scale

 **responsibilities:**

**data ingestion \& integration**

* design and implement scalable, robust data ingestion pipelines that connect cmc and manufacturing source systems — including mes (manufacturing execution systems), process historians, lims, qms, erp platforms, and instrument data sources — to centralized and federated data environments.
* build connectors, adapters, and integration layers that handle the heterogeneous data formats, protocols, and latency profiles characteristic of pharmaceutical manufacturing environments.
* support both batch and real\-time/streaming data patterns, selecting appropriate architectures based on use case requirements.

 **data harmonization \& semantic modeling**

* develop and maintain harmonized data models and ontologies that bring consistency to cmc and manufacturing data across sites, systems, and modalities.
* execute semantic mapping efforts that align source system fields, units, and identifiers to enterprise data standards and scientific meaning.
* collaborate with process scientists, analytical chemists, and manufacturing engineers to ensure data models accurately reflect domain reality.

 **data quality, observability \& governance**

* implement automated data quality controls, validation frameworks, and anomaly detection mechanisms across pipeline layers.
* build and maintain data lineage documentation and metadata infrastructure, enabling full traceability from source system to ai model input.
* establish pipeline observability practices — monitoring, alerting, sla tracking — to ensure data product reliability in production.
* support data governance practices aligned with gxp requirements, 21 cfr part 11, and abbvie data standards.

 **ai/ml enablement \& data product development**

* architect and deliver governed, versioned, reusable data products purpose\-built for ai/ml consumption, including feature stores, curated datasets, and vector\-ready data layers for rag and llm applications.
* partner closely with data scientists, ml engineers, and process modelers to understand model data requirements and translate them into reliable, scalable data infrastructure.
* accelerate ai program delivery by eliminating data bottlenecks — not by workarounds, but by solving root causes structurally.

 **platform \& operational enablement**

* contribute to the design and evolution of pdst's cloud\-based data platform, including lakehouse architecture, data cataloging, access control, and compute infrastructure.
* write and maintain infrastructure\-as\-code, ci/cd pipelines, and automated testing frameworks for data systems.
* support platform onboarding of new cmc data domains and manufacturing sites, ensuring consistent application of standards and patterns.
* provide operational support for production data pipelines, maintaining uptime and data freshness commitments.

 **stakeholder engagement \& scientific leadership**

* influence technical decision\-making without formal authority — earning trust through scientific rigor, transparent methodology, and demonstrated business impact.

  

**qualifications** **required:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, data engineering, information systems, software engineering, bioinformatics, or a closely related technical field plus 2 years’ experience or master’s degree with 0 years' experience.
* respective years of hands\-on experience designing and building enterprise\-grade data pipelines, integration workflows, and data products in complex, multi\-source environments.
* expert\-level proficiency in python for data engineering tasks — pipeline development, transformation logic, data validation, and automation.
* strong sql skills across modern analytical and transactional databases; comfort with both ansi sql and platform\-specific dialects.
* demonstrated experience with cloud data platforms (aws, azure, or gcp) and modern data stack components — including tools such as dbt, spark, airflow, databricks, snowflake, or equivalents.
* develop etl/elt pipelines using tools such as informatica, talend, apache nifi, and cloud\-native services (e.g., aws glue, azure data factory).
* implement master data management (mdm), metadata management, and data cataloging solutions to ensure proper data lineage, accessibility, and compliance.
* set and enforce standards for api development and data integration (rest, graphql, odata), enabling seamless integration using microservices architectures.
* design logical, physical, and conceptual data models using modeling tools (e.g., erwin, powerdesigner, dbt).
* ownership orientation: you define your own problem space, drive solutions to completion, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes — not just outputs.
* solution\-architect instinct: you think before you build, consider the full landscape of available approaches, and choose tools based on fit\-for\-purpose reasoning rather than familiarity or trend.
* scientific integrity: you build models you can explain, defend, and improve — and you apply the same standard to the work of others.
* influence through credibility: you earn the confidence of scientists, engineers, and quality professionals by being right, being clear, and being useful — not by title or volume.
* bias for impact: you are drawn to problems where the stakes are high and the analytical opportunity is real, and you are energized rather than intimidated by ambiguity.

**preferred:**

* experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or other regulated life sciences manufacturing environments.
* familiarity with gxp data principles, 21 cfr part 11 compliance, or data integrity requirements in regulated industries.
* prior exposure to manufacturing source systems such as mes, process historians (e.g., osisoft pi/aveva), lims, qms, or erp platforms
* experience building data infrastructure for ai/ml programs — including feature engineering pipelines, model training datasets, or vector/embedding data layers for rag architectures.

  

**additional information**  

applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law:


* the compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. this range may be modified in the future.
* we offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
* this job is eligible to participate in our short\-term incentive programs.

note: no amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. the amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.

us \& puerto rico only \- to learn more, visit https://www.abbvie.com/join\-us/equal\-employment\-opportunity\-employer.html

description:

we are seeking an experienced **senior data engineer** with strong expertise in **azure databricks, spark, python, sql, and azure data services** to design and develop scalable cloud\-based data solutions for healthcare analytics.

**key responsibilities**

* design, develop, and maintain scalable etl/elt pipelines using **azure databricks, pyspark, azure synapse, and azure data factory**.
* process and integrate both structured and unstructured healthcare data, including **ehr, claims, and related data sources**.
* build and optimize data solutions using **delta lake, azure data lake, azure sql, databricks, and synapse analytics**.
* implement modern **lakehouse architecture** and data warehousing solutions for enterprise analytics.
* support machine learning and predictive analytics initiatives by preparing and engineering high\-quality datasets.
* ensure data quality, integrity, governance, security, and compliance with **hipaa and applicable healthcare regulations**.
* work closely with data scientists, analysts, and software engineers to deliver reliable and high\-performance data solutions.
* implement and maintain **ci/cd pipelines** and automation for data engineering workflows.
* monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance, reliability, and scalability.
* participate in technical design reviews and contribute to data platform architecture decisions.
* follow and promote data engineering best practices across development and production environments.

**required skills \& qualifications**

* 8\+ years of professional experience in **data engineering**, with strong hands\-on experience in azure cloud environments.
* strong expertise in developing data pipelines using **python, sql, spark/pyspark, and azure databricks**.
* solid understanding of **delta lake, lakehouse architecture, data warehousing, and modern data platforms**.
* hands\-on experience with **azure data factory, azure synapse analytics, azure data lake, and azure sql**.
* experience working with healthcare datasets such as **ehr and claims data**.
* strong understanding of healthcare data standards including **fhir and hl7**.
* experience supporting **machine learning, predictive analytics, or data science** initiatives.
* practical experience implementing **devops and ci/cd practices** for data engineering workflows.
* strong understanding of data security, governance, quality, and **hipaa compliance**.
* excellent problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills in an agile environment.
* **azure data engineer or databricks certification** is preferred.

pay: $60\.00 \- $70\.00 per hour

title: Sr AI Developer
description:
**day\-to\-day responsibilities:**
***agentic ai platform development***
* design, build, and maintain production\-grade agentic ai workflows using aws bedrock and modern ai frameworks.
* develop ai systems that combine enterprise knowledge, engineering documentation, and internal data sources to support hardware engineering workflows.
* implement multi\-step reasoning, tool usage, and autonomous task execution within agentic workflows.
* design and optimize prompts, agent architectures, and evaluation frameworks to maximize ai performance and accuracy.

***rag \& knowledge systems***
* build and maintain retrieval\-augmented generation (rag) solutions using embeddings, vector databases, and knowledge bases.
* develop data ingestion, transformation, and indexing pipelines for engineering documentation, design artifacts, and technical datasets.
* design retrieval strategies across structured and unstructured data sources, including graph and search\-based retrieval systems.
* continuously improve retrieval quality, ranking, and response accuracy.

***engineering productivity \& stakeholder engagement***
* partner with hardware engineers, data owners, and cross\-functional stakeholders to identify productivity opportunities and prioritize features.
* gather feedback from engineering users and incorporate findings into future platform enhancements.
* help define product direction, roadmap priorities, and long\-term architecture for the ai platform.
* serve as a technical leader, helping break down complex initiatives into executable workstreams.

***platform reliability, security \& operations***
* implement human\-in\-the\-loop (hil) workflows, validation mechanisms, and governance controls.
* design secure ai systems using enterprise security best practices, including iam, encryption, audit logging, and data protection controls.
* build scalable backend services, apis, and microservices supporting ai workflows.
* debug, test, monitor, and optimize deployed ai solutions for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* support ci/cd pipelines and production deployment processes for ai applications.


**required qualifications:**
***core ai \& agentic development experience***
* proven experience building and deploying production\-grade agentic ai systems.
* strong hands\-on experience with ai workflow development using aws bedrock or comparable cloud ai platforms.
* experience building retrieval\-augmented generation (rag) systems using embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge sources.
* experience implementing agentic workflows, multi\-step reasoning, tool usage, and autonomous task execution.
* familiarity with model context protocol (mcp) and integrating external tools and data sources into ai workflows.
* experience designing evaluation frameworks and validation mechanisms for ai systems.

***software engineering \& backend development***
* strong python development skills.
* experience building backend services, apis, and microservices.
* experience with flask or similar python web frameworks.
* strong understanding of software engineering best practices, testing, debugging, and code quality.
* experience working with ci/cd pipelines and modern software delivery processes.

***cloud \& data engineering***
* experience with cloud\-native application development in aws or similar cloud environments.
* experience building data ingestion, transformation, and indexing pipelines.
* knowledge of aws services including: bedrock, lambda, step functions, eventbridge, s3, dynamodb, kendra, neptune (or similar graph databases)
* experience designing graph\-enhanced or hybrid rag architectures.

***security \& governance***
* experience implementing human\-in\-the\-loop (hil) workflows and ai governance controls.
* understanding of secure ai system design, including:
	+ iam and least\-privilege access
	+ encryption and key management
	+ audit logging
	+ data protection and pii handling
* experience designing reliable distributed systems and asynchronous workflow orchestration.

***candidate profile***
* demonstrated hands\-on experience using agentic ai tools in real\-world development environments.
* strong understanding of how to maximize ai effectiveness through prompt engineering, workflow design, and agent orchestration.
* ability to work independently, define technical direction, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional stakeholders.
* seniority measured by depth of relevant ai and agentic development experience rather than total years of software engineering experience.


**nice\-to\-haves:**
* experience with langchain, langgraph, llamaindex, hugging face, or similar ai frameworks.
* experience building agentic reasoning loops with tool usage through mcp.
* experience implementing hil clarification workflows and human approval checkpoints.
* infrastructure\-as\-code experience using aws cdk (typescript preferred).
* familiarity with model governance frameworks, content classification, and ai safety controls.
* experience with dependency scanning, vulnerability management, and security gates in ci/cd pipelines.
* experience working in monorepo or multi\-package development environments.
* background supporting engineering productivity tools, developer platforms, or internal engineering enablement initiatives.
* experience supporting hardware engineering, cad systems, or engineering knowledge management platforms.
* data science or machine learning background with experience evaluating model performance and accuracy.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. the work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, and data they need to feel their best. here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. join us to start **caring. connecting. growing together.**


as a **senior software engineer** within optum technology, you will drive the design, development, and modernization of scalable enterprise applications supporting high\-throughput healthcare and pharmacy benefit management (pbm) transaction systems. working within an agile environment, you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to build cloud\-native microservices, event\-driven architectures, and secure restful apis. in this role, you will leverage enterprise\-approved ai platforms and modern development tools to boost engineering productivity, deliver high\-quality solutions, and advance our cloud modernization roadmap.


you will enjoy the flexibility to telecommute\* from anywhere within the u.s. as you take on some tough challenges.

**primary responsibilities:**

* design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable microservices, cloud\-native applications, and event\-driven architectures using java, spring boot, docker, and kubernetes across the full software development lifecycle
* implement secure restful apis, relational database solutions, messaging systems (e.g., kafka or jms), and ci/cd pipelines following architectural standards, domain\-driven design (ddd), and devsecops best practices
* design, develop, and deploy ai\-powered solutions to address complex business challenges with an emphasis on responsible use of ai
* leverage enterprise\-approved ai tools and technologies (e.g., github copilot, microsoft copilot) to streamline workflows, automate tasks, improve code quality, and enhance engineering delivery efficiency
* evaluate emerging technology and ai trends to inform solution design, architectural standards, and strategic system modernization
* monitor application health, perform root cause analysis, and troubleshoot issues across environments using observability tools (e.g., splunk, dynatrace, grafana) to ensure high availability for mission\-critical systems
* collaborate within agile/scrum teams with product owners and architects, mentor junior engineers, and promote a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement
* design, develop, and deploy ai\-powered solutions to address complex business challenges with emphasis on responsible use of ai


you'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear directions on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**required qualifications:**

* bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology or 4\+ years of software development experience in lieu of a degree
* 6\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience developing enterprise applications using java, spring boot, rest apis, and microservices architectures
* 4\+ years of experience with event\-driven architectures and messaging platforms such as kafka or jms
* 4\+ years of experience utilizing enterprise monitoring and observability platforms (e.g., dynatrace, splunk, grafana) for application health and performance analysis

meet the team
  
  

our security policy and access team is at the heart of cisco’s mission, building and operating market\-leading platforms like the cisco identity services engine and meraki access manager to simplify security compliance for global organizations. we are a critical engine within our $3b\+ security business group, directly enabling cisco’s strategic pivot to a software\-first, recurring revenue model that secures the world’s most vital networks. you will join a high\-performing, collaborative group of engineers, architects, and product experts who thrive in an agile environment where cross\-functional teamwork is the daily standard. what makes us truly exciting is the scale of our impact; we are building cloud\-native, ai\-integrated solutions that solve the most complex challenges in zero\-trust security and identity management. if you are passionate about owning services from design to production and want to work on a team that values innovation, reliability, and continuous learning, this is the place to make your mark.
  
  

your impact
  
  

the team is made up of builders and problem\-solvers who enjoy tackling complex distributed systems challenges while supporting highly scalable, resilient, and observable services in production. what makes this team especially exciting is the opportunity to work at the intersection of cloud engineering, cybersecurity, automation, and ai\-assisted development while directly influencing products used by some of the world’s largest organizations.
  
  

* design, develop, test, deploy, and support cloud\-native saas applications and services.

minimum qualifications

we are cisco, and our power starts with you.

*

education and experience

knowledge, skills, and abilities

reports to a manager, director, or executive\-level position and does not have any direct reports.

title: Full-Stack PHP Developer
description:
full\-stack php developer


**salary:** $70,000 \- $115,000 doe


**location**: remote (marietta, ga)  

  

**hours:** monday \- friday, 8am \- 5pm eastern

 **about america's best house plans**



america's best house plans is one of the nation's leading online marketplaces for residential home plans. every day, we connect homeowners with architects and designers through a custom\-built ecommerce platform that has been continuously developed and refined over many years.

  

we don’t just maintain a marketing website – we build software. our team of six engineers owns the entire platform, from customer\-facing features to internal tools, search, ecommerce, infrastructure, analytics, and ai initiatives. we value thoughtful engineering, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

 **about the role**



we're looking for an experienced full\-stack php developer who enjoys working across the entire technology stack.



you'll build customer\-facing features, improve internal systems, help maintain our cloud infrastructure, and use ai to make both our customers and our developers more productive.

  

this role is ideal for someone who enjoys variety. one week you may be optimizing sql queries or building new ecommerce functionality. the next you might be improving deployment automation, integrating llms into internal workflows, or diagnosing production performance issues.

  

this position is best suited for engineers who enjoy improving existing systems just as much as building new ones. while we're constantly building new features and modernizing our technology, we also believe that successful software engineering is about making the right technical and business decisions. sometimes the right answer is building something new. sometimes it's thoughtfully enhancing a proven system. we're looking for an engineer who enjoys understanding existing software, improving it where it makes sense, and modernizing it incrementally while balancing business value, maintainability, and risk.



if you're energized by solving complex problems, taking ownership, and leaving a mature system better than you found it, you'll fit right in.

 **what you'll do**


* develop new features for our php\-based ecommerce platform
* improve and modernize existing applications and services
* build responsive interfaces using html, css, and javascript
* design and optimize mysql queries and database schemas
* improve application performance, scalability, and reliability
* maintain linux servers and cloud infrastructure
* enhance ci/cd pipelines and deployment automation
* monitor application health, logging, backups, and system performance
* help design and implement ai\-powered features and internal developer tools
* evaluate and integrate llm apis, prompt engineering techniques, embeddings, and ai workflows where they provide real business value
* participate in architecture discussions and technical planning
* review code and mentor other developers
* troubleshoot production issues across the full stack

 **what we're looking for**


* 7\+ years of professional software development experience
* can comfortably work throughout the entire stack without a framework (using vanilla php, html, css and javascript)
* experience building ai\-powered applications
* experience improving developer productivity through automation and ai
* excellent mysql and sql optimization skills
* experience working directly on linux servers
* experience with git and collaborative development workflows
* solid understanding of http, rest apis, caching, sessions, authentication, and web security
* comfortable debugging issues across frontend, backend, database, and infrastructure
* enjoys owning problems from beginning to end
* takes pride in writing maintainable, practical code that is easy for others to read
* makes pragmatic engineering decisions based on business value, reliability, and long\-term maintainability
* understands that not every problem requires a rewrite—and knows when modernization creates value versus unnecessary risk
* uses ai as a force multiplier—not a replacement for engineering judgment

 **why join us?**


* small engineering team with significant ownership and impact
* modernize and improve an established, successful platform
* work directly with decision\-makers
* opportunity to shape our ai strategy and product direction
* variety of technical challenges across software development and infrastructure
* excellent benefits package

  



if you're excited about building software, improving systems, and helping shape how ai is applied in a real business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Data Engineer
description:
description:
**job status:** exempt (non\-management)

**reports to:** chief information officer

**supervises:** none

**who we are:** at central one, our values are to deliver exceptional service, work as a team, have fun, and the credit union philosophy of people helping people; all while striving to be c.e.n.t.r.a.l. one ambassadors. central stands for caring, enthusiastic, nimble, team\-oriented, resilient, altruistic and loyal. at the core of our values lies a commitment to our community, members, and employees, with a focus on overall well\-being.

**primary functions:**


the data engineer owns the design, build, and ongoing development of cofcu’s enterprise data infrastructure — a modern, scalable platform built on azure and microsoft fabric. this role is the technical engine behind cofcu’s data strategy, responsible for delivering the pipelines, lakehouses, semantic models, and integrations that power trusted reporting, analytics, and ai capabilities across the organization.


the data engineer does not work in isolation. this role operates as a collaborative lead within the data infrastructure team, working closely with business department leaders, data domain owners, the data \& ai governance lead, and cofcu’s managed service provider (msp) to continuously build, refine, and scale the infrastructure. the data engineer is also an active participant in the data \& ai governance framework — applying governance standards, enabling technical implementation of policies, and serving as a technical representative on the data \& ai governance committee.


this position is foundational to cofcu’s shift from manual reporting to a governed, enterprise\-wide data ecosystem — and plays a central role in enabling leadership and staff to access timely, trusted insights that support strategic decision\-making.

**duties and responsibilities:**

**data infrastructure ownership \& development**


own the enterprise data platform end\-to\-end and drive its ongoing evolution in partnership with the msp, domain owners, and it leadership.

* serve as the primary technical owner of cofcu’s data infrastructure, including the data lakehouse/warehouse, ingestion pipelines, transformation layers, and semantic models built on azure and microsoft fabric.
* lead and manage the day\-to\-day execution of the data infrastructure team workstreams, coordinating with the msp to ensure deliverables align with project scope, timelines, and cofcu standards.
* partner with business departments and data domain owners (member, financial, lending, operational, employee, and vendor data) to understand data needs and translate them into infrastructure design and build requirements.
* build and maintain scalable data ingestion, transformation, and storage pipelines for structured and unstructured data from diverse sources including core banking systems, saas platforms, apis, and flat files.
* automate data processing workflows to reduce manual effort, improve reliability, and increase timeliness of data availability.
* manage microsoft purview configuration, data classification, and cataloging as part of the technical governance infrastructure.

**analytics \& reporting enablement**


ensure analysts and business users have access to clean, well\-structured, analytics\-ready data.

* design and maintain semantic models and power bi datasets optimized for performance, consistency, and self\-service consumption.
* collaborate with analysts and business teams to migrate manual reports and spreadsheets to governed power bi dashboards.
* establish and maintain dataset documentation, naming standards, and data dictionaries in coordination with the governance lead.
* enable self\-service analytics by building reusable, well\-documented data products aligned to enterprise data domain definitions.

**data \& ai governance participation**


actively participate in cofcu’s data \& ai governance framework as the technical implementation partner for governance policies and standards.

* serve as a standing technical member of the data \& ai governance committee, representing the infrastructure perspective in governance decisions.
* partner with the data \& ai governance lead to implement governance policies in the platform: data quality checks, access controls, lineage tracking, classification, and auditability.
* apply azure rbac, row\-level security, and microsoft purview sensitivity labels to enforce data access and security governance policies.
* implement and maintain data quality monitoring, alerting, and issue tracking to support governance committee reporting on data reliability.
* contribute to the enterprise data catalog and ensure infrastructure assets are cataloged, documented, and discoverable per governance standards.
* support the technical implementation of ai governance controls, including data lineage and model input/output auditing, where applicable.

**platform security, performance \& reliability**


maintain a secure, high\-performing, and cost\-efficient data environment.

* manage data platform security using azure identity management, rbac, and encryption best practices.
* monitor platform performance, pipeline health, and storage costs; proactively identify and resolve issues.
* implement ci/cd or devops practices for data pipeline and analytics asset deployment to ensure reliable, repeatable releases.
* maintain disaster recovery and business continuity considerations for data infrastructure components.

**collaboration, documentation \& continuous improvement**

* participate in the data infrastructure team channel and working sessions to maintain visibility and alignment across stakeholders.
* contribute to data standards, reusable patterns, and best practices that can be adopted across departments.
* document infrastructure architecture, pipeline design, and data flow to ensure institutional knowledge is retained independently of the msp.
* stay current on azure, microsoft fabric, and purview capabilities; identify and recommend enhancements that advance cofcu’s data strategy.

**additional responsibilities:**

* serves as community role model and participates in volunteer activities to support the people helping people value and enhance the credit union’s visibility.
* adhere to all applicable credit union policies, procedures, and regulations.
* perform other duties as requested or assigned.

**pay range:** $96,000 \- $124,000 per year commensurate with experience

**schedule:** this position is eligible for a hybrid work arrangement with a combination of required in office days and remote days upon completion of in\-office training period.

**experience:** 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data platform development. experience in regulated environments (financial services, healthcare, or similar) strongly preferred. experience managing or coordinating with external vendors or msps on technical deliverables is a plus.

**technical skills:**

* strong proficiency in sql and at least one programming language (python preferred)

title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
description:
**job summary:**


the senior agentic ai engineer is the operational owner of the constituent data layer (cdl) and the safe, secure rollout of ai agents across catertrax® constituent surfaces.  

  

reporting to the director, enterprise architecture as a member of the data layer group, this engineer manages the cdl schema, the agent registry, and the policy engine that governs which agents can access which data under which conditions, and instruments the data flywheel that returns outcomes from agent actions back into the layer.  

  

the role partners with the director of strategic solutions on brief\-to\-agent translation, with the director, product and solutions on engineering intake, with platform engineering on runtime, and with finance on data flywheel roi metrics. without this role, agents would be built ad hoc across teams with no shared governance; this seat ensures they are not.**job description:**

**essential duties and responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

**constituent data layer ownership**

* manage the constituent data layer schema, including versioning, integrity, and evolution as constituent surfaces expand.
* own the agent registry: the authoritative record of every agent operating across catertrax surfaces.
* build and operate the policy engine governing which agents can access which data under which conditions.
* establish and maintain shared governance so agents are built on the cdl rather than ad hoc across teams.

**agent development \& safe rollout**

* design, build, and deploy ai agents across constituent surfaces on the shared platform substrate.
* implement guardrails, evaluation harnesses, and monitoring for agent behavior in production.
* define and operate the rollout process for new agents, including staged release, human oversight, and rollback.
* lead incident response for agent behavior issues, including root\-cause analysis and remediation.

 **data flywheel \& measurement**

* instrument the data flywheel that returns outcomes from agent actions back into the constituent data layer.
* partner with finance to define and report data flywheel roi metrics.
* ensure agent telemetry supports both product improvement and executive decision\-making.

**cross\-functional partnership**

* partner with the director of strategic solutions on brief\-to\-agent translation, converting constituent problem framing into agent designs.
* partner with the director, product and solutions on engineering intake and sequencing.
* partner with platform engineering on agent runtime, deployment, and operational readiness.

**engineering excellence**

* uphold engineering standards, code review practices, and documentation quality across all data layer work.
* embed security and privacy by design into every agent and data\-layer decision.

**qualifications and experience includes**

description:
puget sound energy is looking to grow our community with top talented individuals like you! with our rapidly growing, award winning energy efficiency programs, our pathway to an exciting and innovative future is now.

  

pse's communications \& marketing team is looking for qualified candidates to fill an open **marketing data scientist** position!

**job description**
-------------------


pse’s communications strategy team is looking for a marketing data scientist to lead the development, measurement, and optimization of marketing, customer engagement, and communications performance through advanced analytics, data science, and business intelligence. this role integrates marketing strategy with data\-driven insights to support companywide marketing efforts and corporate priorities. the most successful candidate will be able to use storytelling to present data to internal and external stakeholders, translate data into actionable items, and move data between multiple sources and programs.

  

the responsibilities of this role combine statistical analysis, machine learning, and business analytics to evaluate campaign performance, forecast customer behavior, and optimize marketing effectiveness. additionally they develop production\-quality models, dashboards, and reporting frameworks that enable data\-driven decision\-making across marketing and customer experience functions.

  

the marketing data scientist will need to partner cross\-functionally with marketing, customer insights, analytics, regulatory, and external agencies to deliver actionable insights that improve engagement, enhance customer experience, and support corporate goals.

  

all pse employees are expected to uphold the safety compliance standards inherent in pse’s operating and/or field procedures related to work responsibilities and promote and support a culture of total safety. additionally, employees need to demonstrate commitment to conduct business honestly, ethically and consistent with our core values and code of conduct. all duties are to be performed in accordance with all regulatory compliance obligations.

* develop and maintain dashboards and reporting frameworks.

* performs other duties as assigned.

* proficiency with python or r.
* strong working knowledge of sql.
* experience with visualization tools like tableau or power bi.

* ability to collaborate and participate in direct data science and data management projects and project teams.
* familiar with all categories of security and regulated data and information.

title: Senior Automation Engineer
description:
**automation engineer – power automate (healthcare operations)**

**contract to permanent**

**job summary** we are seeking a seasoned senior automation engineer to lead the rapid delivery of high\-impact automation solutions within a healthcare payer environment. in this role, you will act as a lead developer and lead automation solution design. you will be responsible for analyzing complex business workflows in clinical, enrollment, provider, it operations etc and converting them into streamlined, automated processes. you will own the assessment phase to identify repetitive, rules\-based tasks that offer the highest roi and build robust, scalable solutions. you will prioritize modern generative ai approaches over legacy rpa methods where applicable to reduce maintenance overhead.

**key responsibilities**

* process mining and discovery: lead workshops with business stakeholders in enrollment, provider, clinical, it etc to map workflows. identify manual, repetitive workflows with clear logic and quantify the potential time savings and roi of automation.
* automation solution: design end\-to\-end automation workflows that integrate modern cloud apps like sharepoint with specific healthcare and data systems including careradius, anchor point, and databricks.
* generative ai implementation: leverage ai tools such as gemini to replace complex rule\-based scraping with intelligent parsing. design workflows that use large language models to summarize clinical notes or extract data from unstructured provider emails instead of building brittle rpa loops.
* advanced development: build complex, automations using power automate desktop (and similar rpas) and cloud flows. handle advanced logic, error handling, and exception management using modern ai connectors.
* governance and mentorship: establish coding standards and secure by design principles for the automation team. provide technical guidance and code reviews for the junior automation engineer.
* integration strategy: write custom connectors or scripts using powershell, python, or json to bridge gaps where out\-of\-the\-box connectors do not exist.

**education and experience**

* **education:** bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical field.
* **experience:**


	+ 8\+ years in software development or data engineering, with a strong emphasis on etl
	+ 5\+ years expert\-level proficiency in microsoft power platform including power automate cloud and desktop. strong proficiency in api integration via rest or soap and sql.
	+ 5\+ years of extensive experience working with sql databases, nosql environments, and complex api integrations within a healthcare context.
	+ proven success in processing large volumes of unstructured medical data using ocr, nlp, and document ai technologies.
	+ experience building automated testing frameworks to validate the accuracy of ai outputs in regulated environments.
	+ leadership in managing the deployment of bots in virtualized environments and ensuring 24/7 operational stability.
	+ demonstrated ability to use generative ai tools like gemini, claude, or openai apis to solve automation problems. experience prompting llms to structure unstructured data.

as a desktop ui developer, you will design and build the circuit desktop application—a native\-grade, cross\-platform experience for macos and windows that brings ai\-driven productivity to the desktop. you bring the full skill set of a modern web ui developer (angular, node.js, gcp, figma\-driven ux, rest apis) and extend it to the desktop, bridging the gap between our web application and the operating system.
  
**you will own the desktop shell end\-to\-end:** application lifecycle, os\-level integrations (system tray, notifications, deep linking, always\-on presence), installers, and safe auto\-updates. this is a high\-visibility, high\-ownership role where you will define how tens of thousands of cisco employees experience circuit as a first\-class desktop citizen.
  
  

responsibilities
  
  

design, build, and maintain the circuit desktop application for macos and windows using electron (or tauri) with an angular/typescript ui, ensuring a consistent, performant, native\-grade experience across both platforms.
  
  

implement desktop\-specific functionality—system tray, native notifications, file system access, deep linking, global shortcuts, and always\-on ambient presence—architecting clean ipc communication between the ui (renderer) and main processes with context isolation and sandboxing.
  
  

build responsive ai\-driven interfaces (chat, agents, streaming responses) from figma designs and ux frameworks, integrating with rest apis and node.js services, and reusing circuit's web design system on the desktop surface.
  
  

own cross\-platform build pipelines and installers (dmg/pkg for macos, msi/nsis for windows), including code signing and macos notarization, hardened runtime, and reliable differential auto\-updates.
  
  

integrate native modules where needed (swift/objective\-c on macos, c\+\+/c\# on windows), and profile and optimize startup time, memory, and cpu usage; debug native crashes and manage large local state (sqlite/indexeddb).
  
  

deploy supporting services on google cloud platform, contribute to a multi\-platform ci/cd matrix, and collaborate within an agile team of designers, backend, platform, and quality engineers.
  
  

work with ux and ui designers throughout the product lifecycle, from early feasibility conversations through build and release. participate in design reviews, give honest input on what is feasible in code, and help scope work so designs can ship without last\-minute compromises.
  
  

build interfaces using a shared component library and design tokens, extending existing patterns instead of writing one\-off styles. keep ui consistent, theme\-aware, and maintainable as the product grows.
  
  

implement wcag 2\.2 aa patterns for dynamic ai interfaces, including aria live regions for streaming responses, semantic structure for conversation uis, focus management across modals and context switches, full keyboard support, and color contrast in light and dark modes.
  
  

**research\-informed implementation:** apply findings from usability testing and end\-user feedback during development. know when a design is ready to build versus still in exploration, and raise gaps or edge cases with designers before they become production issues.
  
  

**human\-ai interaction ui:** build front\-end patterns that help users understand ai behavior: streaming and token\-by\-token rendering, clear loading and error states, recovery flows when responses fail, and ui that supports trust and comprehension in non\-deterministic experiences. this is a hybrid position.
  
  

minimum qualifications
  
  

* bachelor’s degree with 6\+ years, master’s degree with 4\+ years, or phd with 1\+ year of experience in computer science or a related technical field.
* proficiency in angular, typescript/javascript, and node.js, with a strong focus on translating figma designs into scalable, component\-based uis using formal design systems.
* proven ability to build and ship secure production desktop applications for macos and windows using electron or tauri, with deep knowledge of application lifecycles, ipc, and security best practices.
* experience managing cross\-platform packaging, code signing, and auto\-update mechanisms, complemented by practical experience deploying and running services on google cloud platform (gcp).
* proficiency in git and agile methodologies, with a specialized focus on implementing advanced accessibility standards for dynamic, real\-time web uis.


preferred qualifications
  
  

* experience building web\-based or desktop ai applications, including llm/chatbot/agent interfaces, streaming responses, and real\-time updates via websockets.
* proficiency in writing native modules (swift/objective\-c for macos; c\+\+/c\# and win32 apis for windows) and experience with performance profiling to optimize electron overhead (startup time, memory, and cpu usage).
* experience building and maintaining a multi\-platform ci/cd matrix using github actions (e.g., running macos\-latest and windows\-latest in parallel with secure signing secrets) and familiarity with docker for containerized development.
* experience with local/offline storage solutions (sqlite, indexeddb, filesystem) and managing efficient large\-scale local state.
* familiarity with os\-level accessibility apis and deep integration of desktop accessibility/wcag standards.
* strong problem\-solving, effective communication, and a proven track record of hands\-on ownership of complex features and projects.


why cisco?
  
  

at cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the ai era – and beyond. we’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. these solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. we work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
we are cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer — AI Agent Systems
description:
**senior full\-stack engineer \- ai agent systems**

taxflow · accounting \& taxation platform · full\-time · remote (usa\-based)

**about taxflow**

taxflow is a tax\-preparation platform for cpa firms. we take the most document\-heavy, deadline\-driven workflow in professional services \- the annual tax return \- and rebuild it around ai: documents arrive, get classified and extracted by an agent pipeline, land in a per\-return workspace ("binder") as reviewable, cited values, and flow through preparation workpapers to the firm’s tax software. firms keep the judgment; the platform does the shuffling.

this is real\-money, real\-compliance software. taxpayer pii, irs pub 4557 / ftc safeguards obligations, audit trails, immutable records. accuracy is not a nice\-to\-have \- it is the product.

**the role**

you’ll be the second engineer, working directly with the founding team across the whole platform \- and you’ll do it in an **agent\-native workflow**: we build with parallel ai coding agents, where engineers set direction, write sharp specs, review rigorously, and orchestrate agent teams rather than typing every line. if your instinct on a complex migration is "spec it precisely, fan it out, verify adversarially," you’ll feel at home.

your center of gravity:

* **ai / agent systems (the core of the role).** design and harden the document\-intelligence pipeline: multi\-step agent harnesses for classification, extraction, and review of tax documents (w\-2s, k\-1s, 1099s, organizers, prior\-year returns); prompt/tool design; structured outputs; confidence scoring and citation of extracted values; evals and regression suites so quality is measured, not vibes.
* **backend.** postgres data modeling in a strictly multi\-tenant schema (70\+ tables, db\-first with drizzle), server functions, background job orchestration (inngest), document storage (r2/s3\), and vendor integrations \- cch axcess import/export, irs mef, third\-party extraction apis \- kept behind clean adapter seams.
* **full\-stack product.** ship vertical slices end to end in our tanstack start \+ react app: extraction\-review uis, spreadsheet\-grade workpapers, pipeline/kanban views. you don’t need to be a designer; you do need to care that a preparer can trust what’s on screen.
* **devops (a solid working share).** own our path from "works locally" to boring, observable production on **aws**: deploy pipelines, ci, environments and secrets, monitoring/alerting, backup and retention posture, and the data\-residency/security requirements that come with taxpayer data. nothing exotic \- it just has to be right, because tax season doesn’t reschedule.

**our stack (what you’d actually touch)**

* **monorepo:** turborepo \+ pnpm, node 24, typescript end to end, vitest
* **app:** tanstack start (ssr react), tailwind v4, shadcn/ui on base ui primitives
* **data:** postgresql (neon in prod, docker locally), drizzle orm, db\-first schema, firm\_id tenancy on every domain table
* **ai:** multi\-provider llm stack (anthropic claude today, provider\-agnostic by design \- openai, gemini, and open models where they fit) driving the agent pipeline for document classification, extraction, and review; structured outputs, per\-document extraction specs, eval harnesses
* **jobs \& storage:** inngest, cloudflare r2 / s3\-compatible storage (minio locally)
* **auth:** self\-hosted better auth
* **integrations:** cch axcess bridge, irs mef, summedd extraction api \- isolated adapters
* **hosting:** aws (production); github\-based flow

**what you’ve done before (requirements)**

* **6\+ years building production software**, with at least 2 recent years shipping **llm/agent\-powered features** to real users \- agent loops or harnesses, tool use / function calling, rag or document pipelines, eval frameworks. you can talk concretely about failure modes you hit and how you measured your way out.
* **strong backend fundamentals:** relational data modeling, transactions, migrations, queues/background jobs, idempotency, api design. comfortable owning a postgres schema that other things depend on.
* **fluent typescript across the stack** and at ease in a modern react codebase (we use tanstack start; next.js experience translates fine).
* **enough devops to own production:** aws experience \- ci/cd, environment/secret management, networking basics, monitoring, and incident hygiene. you’ve stood up and run production infrastructure yourself, not just consumed someone else’s.
* **rigor.** you write specs before code when it matters, test what can silently be wrong, and treat "the model said so" as a hypothesis, not an answer.
* comfortable working **with ai coding agents** as a force multiplier \- directing, reviewing, and correcting them \- not threatened by them, not blindly trusting them.

**nice to have**

* fintech, accounting, tax, or other regulated/compliance\-heavy domain experience (pii handling, audit trails, retention/worm, soc 2 groundwork)
* document\-ai specifics: ocr/vision\-model extraction, layout parsing, confidence calibration, human\-in\-the\-loop review ux
* experience with any of: drizzle, inngest, better auth, neon, cloudflare r2, turborepo
* prior early\-stage experience \- you’ve been engineer \#1–5 somewhere and know what "owning it" means

**how we work**

* **small, senior, direct.** you work with the founding team daily; decisions are made in hours, not sprints.
* **agent\-native development.** plans and specs live in the repo; ai coding agents do much of the mechanical work in parallel; humans own architecture, correctness, and review. the bottleneck we care about is ambiguity, not typing speed.
* **vertical slices, verified end to end.** no layer\-by\-layer phases; everything ships behind quality gates (typecheck, tests) with real data flowing.
* **correctness culture.** tax numbers, tenancy boundaries, and audit trails get the paranoid treatment: root\-cause fixes over patches, tests over promises.

**details**

* **compensation:** usd 120,000 – 130,000
* **location:** remote, usa\-based. mid to west coast preferred for timezone. you will need timezone overlap with both new york and sydney, australia. rare travel to new york for an in\-person meeting may be required.
* **start:** as soon as you can

**hiring process**

1\. **intro call** (30 min) \- mutual fit, your ai/agent war stories

2\. **technical deep\-dive** (60 min) \- walk us through a system you built: an agent pipeline or a backend you owned; we’ll dig into the decisions

3\. **working test session** \- a realistic slice of our world (e.g. design an extraction eval, or spec \+ build a small vertical slice with agent tooling)

4\. **final discussion and offer**

**to apply**

email **jobs@summedd.com**. include something you’ve built with llms that you’re proud of \- a repo, a demo, or a write\-up of the hard parts.

pay: $120,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year

work location: remote

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
*build the engine behind grid intelligence, from raw sensor data to the ratings that utilities act on.*


we are seeking a **senior software engineer** to join our linerate team and build full\-stack systems that turn massive time\-series sensor data into the ratings our utility customers rely on. you will work across the ratings generation library, our customer\-deployable product, weather modeling tools, and the front end visualizations that surface it all. if you want to own hard technical problems end\-to\-end and help shape how utilities get affordable, reliable power onto the grid, join us at linevision, *built in boston best places to work*!

### **what will you do?**

**core responsibilities and key performance objectives**

* collaborate with data scientists to productionalize core computational functionality, turning research code into reliable, scalable services.
* work with ui/ux teams to design and build apis that surface the right data at the right time.
* design efficient storage and retrieval strategies for massive time\-series data sets.
* contribute across our core codebases: the ratings generation library and its microservice, the slimmed\-down customer\-deployable product, weather modeling tools, and front end visualizations.
* advise product on roadmap priorities, balancing customer benefit against time to implement.

**within the first 3 months:**

* ship meaningful contributions to at least one core codebase (ratings library, customer product, weather modeling, or front end) with minimal guidance.
* build working relationships with data science and ui/ux counterparts and understand how the codebases connect.
* demonstrate command of our python/typescript stack and time\-series data patterns.

**within the first 6 months:**

* own an end\-to\-end feature that spans backend logic and the apis or ui that expose it.
* contribute a concrete improvement to how we store or retrieve time\-series data at scale.
* participate in roadmap discussions, bringing a technical point of view on feasibility and tradeoffs.

**within the first year:**

* become a go\-to resource for at least one core codebase, trusted with architectural decisions.
* lead a cross\-functional initiative with data science or ui/ux from scoping through delivery.
* mentor at least one other engineer through code review, pairing, and consistent feedback.

### **how to succeed in this role**

**key competencies**

* **critical thinking:** analyze complex problems in ratings generation, weather modeling, or time\-series storage independently and propose sound solutions. demonstrate a curious mindset in exploring new approaches.
* **delivering innovative solutions:** devise and iterate on technical solutions with a growth mindset. bring creative, well\-reasoned approaches to novel problems across the stack.
* **taking ownership:** lead projects with minimal supervision, taking full ownership of outcomes. communicate proactively when scope or technical constraints shift.
* **follow through – execution:** deliver quality work on time. resolve open questions proactively with stakeholders and hold yourself accountable to team commitments.
* **empowering others:** mentor junior engineers and share knowledge freely. foster a supportive team environment where outcomes matter more than individual output.

**essential skills**

* proficiency in python and javascript/typescript, with working experience in react.
* experience with at least one relational database and one nosql database.
* experience deploying and operating on a major cloud platform.
* comfort working across the stack, from data storage through apis to ui.

**what sets the best candidates apart**

* experience with kubernetes.
* experience with rust.
* experience working with large\-scale time\-series data sets.
* background collaborating closely with data science or applied science teams to productionize research code.

**reporting \& team structure**

* reports to the **senior software engineering manager**
* collaborates closely with data science, ui/ux, and product teams.

**interview process**

* apply online.
* round 1: phone screen (recruiter)
* round 2: hiring manager interview
* round 3: panel interviews
	+ panel 1: technical competency \& experience
	+ panel 2: teamwork, collaboration and communication
* final round: leadership team \& hiring manager sign\-off (onsite)

### **what does joining linevision mean for you?**

* **impact.** your talent, time, and energy will critically impact our success in accelerating our mission of providing utilities with grid intelligence to enable affordable, reliable power.
* **ownership.** you will hold broad responsibilities with high autonomy and trust in a communicative, collaborative, and fast\-paced environment.
* **flexibility.** you will be empowered to maintain work\-life balance with trust\-based pto and a flexible hybrid work schedule.
* **real world innovation.** you will join a motivated and high\-performing team working with cutting edge, patented technology to help solve key obstacles to meet the demands of an ai\-powered future.

### **who we are...**


linevision is a grid\-enhancing technology company enabling electric utilities to deliver affordable, reliable power and accelerate the electrification of the global economy. our grid intelligence platform delivers the most accurate, network\-wide dynamic line ratings and enables safer, more reliable grid operations with a combination of optical sensors and advanced environmental modeling. linevision's global customer base includes eight of the ten largest us utilities, including national grid, southern company, and exelon.


we are linevisionaries:

* **we are innovators:** we light the way with tenacious creativity and do good work.
* **we are empowered:** with high trust and high autonomy, the floor is yours, and the opportunity is ours.
* **we are welcoming**: come as you are, our doors are open. we are better together.
* **we are trusted partners:** we elevate our customer champions through shared thought leadership. we deliver on commitments.
* **we are all in**: we are building a community of passionate individuals who want to dent the universe.

description:

title: Insights & Analytics Senior Specialist
description:

location: gaithersburg, usa


hybrid: 3 days a week onsite


**insights \& analytics senior specialist** translates complex business and scientific challenges into practical, scalable machine learning solutions


the role contributes across the machine learning lifecycle, from understanding the problem and assessing the available data through to model development, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. it requires the ability to make sound technical decisions, explain them clearly, and balance innovation with the expectations of a regulated and quality\-focused environment.


**typical accountabilities**


* **translate needs into solutions**: work with stakeholders to understand business or scientific problems, assess whether machine learning is an appropriate approach, and define clear objectives, success measures, and delivery plans.
* **develop machine learning solutions**: design, build, evaluate, and improve models using appropriate statistical and machine learning techniques. this may include deep learning approaches for structured, text, image, or other unstructured data.
* **work with advanced ai methods**: apply modern approaches such as natural language processing, generative ai and ai agents/workflows based on the problem being addressed. select methods based on their suitability, performance, maintainability, and governance requirements.
* **deliver production\-ready capabilities**: work beyond experimentation to ensure that models can be packaged, deployed, integrated with relevant systems, monitored, and maintained over time. contribute to the design of reliable and scalable ai architectures.
* **use cloud and engineering practices**: develop and deploy solutions using cloud platforms such as **aws** or **microsoft azure**, and use technologies such as **docker**, source control, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery to support consistent and reproducible delivery.
* **maintain quality and governance**: define appropriate data and model quality criteria, validate results, document assumptions, and consider issues such as explainability, bias, privacy, security, performance degradation, and responsible use of ai.
* **communicate with clarity**: present technical findings and recommendations in a way that is meaningful to both technical and non\-technical audiences. communicate model performance, uncertainty, limitations, and risks openly so stakeholders can make informed decisions.
* **provide technical leadership**: contribute to technical design discussions, code and model reviews, reusable components, engineering standards, and communities of practice. provide guidance and informal mentoring to colleagues where appropriate.
* **operate as an individual contributor**: deliver work within agreed scope and priorities, influencing through technical expertise, collaboration, and sound judgement rather than through formal line management.
* **work within the relevant country remit**: comply with applicable local policies, standards, regulatory expectations, and organizational requirements.

**qualifications and skills**


**essential**


* bachelor’s degree in **computer science, data science, artificial intelligence, engineering, mathematics, statistics**, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* typically **at least five years of experience** as a data scientist, machine learning engineer, ai engineer, or in a related role. experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, life sciences, or another regulated and data\-intensive environment is particularly relevant.
* demonstrated experience taking machine learning work from problem definition and data preparation through to model evaluation and, deployment or operational use.
* experience working with text, images, or other unstructured data, including relevant methods in **natural language processing** or **computer vision**. understanding of modern deep learning architectures, including the role of **attention mechanisms** and transformer\-based models.
* strong programming experience in **python**, with the ability to write maintainable, tested, and reusable code. experience working with databases, apis, and data pipelines is also expected.
* experience using at least one major cloud platform, preferably **aws or microsoft azure**, to develop, train, deploy, or operate machine learning solutions.
* experience with **docker** and familiarity with software engineering and mlops practices such as version control, testing, deployment automation, experiment tracking, monitoring, and model lifecycle management.

the annual base pay for this position ranges from $93,868\.00 \- $140,802\.00 usd. our positions offer eligibility for various incentives—an opportunity to receive short\-term incentive bonuses, equity\-based awards for salaried roles and commissions for sales roles. benefits offered include qualified retirement programs, paid time off (i.e., vacation, holiday, and leaves), as well as health, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

we are not building a traditional bi function.


we are building an ai\-augmented analytics capability that:
